claim: Authored a Unity Creative Core design document for ArchitecTour, a web and AR tool for previewing architectural construction proposals.
detail: Scoped a brutalist modern building showcase enabling architects and real estate developers to inspect interiors, exteriors, materials, and colors at construction sites.

claim: Defined multi-angle camera presets, audio elements, and UI interaction controls for a Unity 3D visualization scene.
detail: Included wide-angle, mid-range, and close-up camera views, camera-switching UI buttons, exterior nature audio, calming music, and an audio controls menu.

claim: Specified Unity 3D rendering requirements covering custom shaders, baked lighting, animation, particle VFX, and post-processing.
detail: Planned realistic surface materials, a custom TV screen shader, dynamic sunlight time-of-day, idling cutout figures, animated sculpture, dust and firefly VFX, bloom, and vignette.
